# Raijin Hydroelectric (LV-670)
[italic]Date 2179 - LV-670 Raijin Hydroelectric (formerly known as Trijent Dam), a Three World Empire water treatment facility serving a major prospera.[/italic]
[bold]Raijin Hydroelectric[/bold], formerly the [bold]Trijent Dam[/bold], powers the lithium mining colony of [bold]Oxley's Butte[/bold] on the planet Raijin, in [textlink="Three World Empire" link="CMUGuideLoreTWE"] (TWE) space in the Neroid Sector.
## History - A TWE orbital telescope first catalogued LV-670 in 2096 as an unremarkable world. Nineteen years later, a research vessel's sensors revealed it might be rich in lithium. - In 2120 [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"] sent a probe that confirmed huge deposits of a rare lithium isotope, an extraordinary find. - Landfall came in 2129, a joint venture between the [bold]Trijent Corporation[/bold], a W-Y colonial development subsidiary, and the research group that found the lithium. The captain of the exploration vessel, a devout follower of reformed Shinto, named the planet [bold]Raijin[/bold] after the Japanese god of thunder. - Oxley's Butte was founded months later at a river fork in the northern hemisphere. To power it, Trijent hired the Cebrini group to build a hydroelectric dam, completed in 2150. Full colonization was finished by 2161.
## The Colony - Most colonists work for Trijent or Cebrini, with independent contractors handling logistics, catering and hospitality. - Security is provided by the [bold]Neroid Sector Policing Authority[/bold] (NSPA), the TWE's regional police, alongside Weyland-Yutani's own internal security. The NSPA can enforce most laws, but knows it will be sidelined the moment the Company or its employees are accused of anything. - For almost two decades the colony's lithium has been sold to refiners breeding [bold]tritium[/bold], letting Trijent, and so W-Y, corner the tritium market and make fusion fuel far cheaper. - In 2175, reporters picked up frantic messages from Oxley's Butte requesting specialists in xenoarchaeology and xenofauna. The Company dismissed the reports as false alarms, and a string of scandals in the TWE parliament soon pushed the story out of the news.
## Raijin A smaller, harsher cousin of Earth with two barren, tidally locked moons, Fujin and Raitaro. Its equator is a burning desert without surface water, while the temperate north and south hold three continents, glacier-fed mountain ranges and two great oceans.
